history.summary: Found suspended-provider booking exposure, admin lists capped without pagination, and missing workflow-level tests. Direct quality checks passed, but npm test/build/dev pre-hooks failed on Prisma client generation with Windows EPERM; browser verification was inconclusive.
Code addressed suspension, admin pagination/search, and workflow test coverage, but workflow tests were skipped due to missing DATABASE_URL_TEST; independent DB route verification could not run.
Automated workflow tests ran reproducibly against temporary PostgreSQL, but provider active bookings are capped at 100 with no pagination/search.
Provider active requests are paginated with ownership-scoped queries; PostgreSQL regression verifies records beyond the first 100, and lint, tests, and build pass.
